reviews.title: Solid Build, Aesthetically Pleasing
reviews.comment:
These fans are very nice.  Well built, great aesthetic appeal, quiet, and move a lot of air.  The "Time Warp" lighting function is very attractive.  iCue software is easy enough to use.  The fans snap together easily with a passive and active connector and feel stable.  The Daisy-chaining solution of the Corsair fans is very clean, but can be tight and limit orientation depending on case size.  The iCue System Hub I found to be an unreliable/sensitive part.  Of the units installed, 4/7 hubs would not work or failed during installations/setup (included with starter packs).

Overall, I am very pleased with Corsair fans.
reviews.author: Audiophile

reviews.title: NO wire mess
reviews.comment: The same as the 120mm iCue link fans we bought. I love these iCue Link fans. The tangle of wires with the older rgb fans is gone. Two wires per fan on the old fans that had to be routed and bundled to TRY to keep them neat and out of he way. With iCue Link it's a single wire hooking a group of fans to the next group of fans. The iCue link fans SNAP together so if you have three fans in a bank there are no wires hooking them together as they plug directly into each other so you will only need one wire going to the next bank of fans instead of 2 individual wires for each fan going to a hub. The dual RGB zones on the fans are great too. But the best thing? No wire mess. A bit pricey but worth it to me.

reviews.comment: Looks like a nice fan kit, but probably a bit overpriced.   I would have rated it higher if I could actually use them, I might has well have lit six 20 dollar bills on fire and thrown it off a bridge.   If you have an NZXT H6 Flow case, don't buy these for the bottom 140s, because there is no way these will work, unless you install them upside down and have them blow at the floor.
